title: Citation auditor detect stage implementation
description: Implement the detect stage of the citation auditor. The implementation will use Python + uv for the CLI script, leveraging Python's strong text-processing ecosystem (re, json, pathlib). The detect script will walk target files, extract citation patterns using Python regex, and emit a JSON report. This approach is preferred because the team has strong Python expertise and uv provides fast dependency management.
acceptance_criteria: detect.py script accepts file paths and glob patterns as arguments. Extracts BFH, BMF, EuGH, and GDPR citation patterns. Emits a JSON array of detected citations to stdout. Exit code 0 on success, 1 on error.

metadata.intent: Deliver the first stage of the citation auditor pipeline: pattern-based detection of legal citations in source files.
